data.description:
## Incident Overview
context_window_fallbacks= is a LiteLLM Router constructor parameter, not a litellm.completion() keyword argument. When passed to litellm.completion(), it is silently accepted and ignored. The parameter was implemented in dispatch.py and required an upstream code review cycle to detect the issue.

## Root Cause
LiteLLM SDK documentation does not clearly distinguish Router-only parameters from completion()-compatible parameters. The parameter was assumed to work based on naming similarity.

## Fix Applied
Manual inner loop over context_model_chain was restored. The broken parameter was removed. See commit 29dfaff69a.

## Prevention
Before implementing any LiteLLM SDK parameter, verify it against litellm.completion() source code (not just docs). The Router interface is separate from the completion() interface.
